filed: 2026-11-13, before any run. Plan: reports/plans/2026-11-13_plan_simplest-intervention-ranking.md. Code: experiments/simplest_intervention/run.py, src/commute/rank_read.py. Every reading is 'under the fourth wording, ranked, provisional (testing only, not adopted)'. Names below are the keys run.py writes in results/<item>.json (readings[list][bar] = {rung, n, names | edits, pair}) and results/run<k>.json.
question: Under the fourth reuse wording, read by a ranking of interventions on M's list of variables (fixed on M alone): do the controls built on that list read their built rungs, does the twin fine-tune rank below the memorised fact on both seeds, and does each old pair's reuse side rank at or below its new side?

threshold_sources.bars: the plan: every reading at 0.8, 0.9 and 0.95; which holds is the user's
threshold_sources.cap: the plan: rungs 1 and 2 capped at 16 names (~240 bits, far below one free 768-number direction)
threshold_sources.kl_floor: rung 0 when KL(F || M) on the read subset is under max(kl_floor, 10 x the do-nothing's KL read in run 1). Two runs of the 67M differ by 1.03e-5 in mean TV (built_control_sum/results/amend1_stage0.json floor_runs_tv), a KL of order 1e-10; every built edit is calibrated to a TV gap of 0.229 (KL of order 0.1). 1e-6 sits four orders above the first and five below the second
threshold_sources.r1_bar: the card: the twin's and the fact's lowest rung at bar 0.9
threshold_sources.gap_tol: E157's and E173's gap_tol for a calibrated planted edit (run 1's controls are calibrated the same way)
threshold_sources.reload_tol: E168's and E173's reload_tol: a rebuilt F's mean TV gap must repeat E173's

measures.kl: KL(F || M) in nats at the last position, mean over 16,384 seeded read-half windows
measures.closure: 1 - KL(F || M_I) / KL(F || M) on the same read windows, I fitted on the fit half
measures.curve: lists[list][rung].curve: after each greedy step, n (writes plus reads), the closure, the names
measures.rung3: lists[list]['3'].fits: closure of one, then two, free rank-one edits h_s += rms_s d (a . (h_r - mu_r) / rms_r + c) at each (r <= s) in in1, in2, in3, out3, with the list's rung-2 names kept and refitted
measures.reading: readings[list][bar]: rung 0 if kl under the floor; else the lowest (rung, n) whose closure is at least the bar: rung 1 then 2 at the smallest n on its curve, rung 3 at the fewest edits, else rung 4
measures.lists: neurons (4 x 3,072 MLP neurons), directions (top 64 principal directions at in0..in3, out3), all; the input tokens at the last two positions (read) and the logits (write) are in every list

run1_stop.rule: after each run-1 item: any miss below writes run1.json passed false, exits 1, nothing further runs, runs 2 and 3 refuse, the cell closes 'no call'. A calibration that cannot reach the target gap within gap_tol also exits 1 (run1.json not written, so runs 2 and 3 refuse)

expected._rule: descriptive, read at list all and bar 0.9 ('as expected' when misses is empty); every other list and bar is reported beside it. always_on, table and planted_fact have no expected reading in the plan and are measured only

R1.measure: run2.json R1, from readings['all']['0.9'].rung of twin_s0, twin_s1, fact_s0, fact_s1
R1.rival_a: the twin's rung at most 2 and the fact's at least 3, on both seeds: the twin reuses a variable M has, the fact's random token set is not on M's list
R1.rival_b: the twin and the fact at the same rung on each seed: the ranking does not separate them
R1.else: no call (mixed seeds, or different rungs both under 3 or both over 2)

R2.measure: run3.json R2: for each old pair (copy24/cipher24, ident32/rand32, case_real/case_twin, repeat_real/repeat_twin) and seed, readings['all']['0.9'].rung
R2.claim: the reuse side's rung at or below the new side's for every pair and seed (all_hold true)
R2.note: equal rungs hold; descriptive, the third wording's ordering as a grade

edge_cases.do_nothing: KL(F || M) is under the floor: rung 0 at every bar and list, no search run and no closure divided (the zero-denominator case cannot be reached)
edge_cases.kl_at_floor: KL exactly at the floor is not under it: searched
edge_cases.closure_at_bar: a closure exactly at a bar passes (EPS 1e-9)
edge_cases.ties_reading: the first n on a curve to reach the bar; at rung 3, fewer edits first, then the pair of the highest closure
edge_cases.ties_search: equal scores keep topk's order (the lower variable index); a write's gain and shift are separate candidates
edge_cases.no_candidate: a greedy search with no candidate left (or n at the cap) stops; its curve ends there
edge_cases.skipped_rungs: a rung is not searched once a lower rung of that list reached the top bar (0.95): it cannot lower any reading. Two rank-one edits are not fitted once one reached it
edge_cases.empty_or_missing_item: an item not done misses every spec; R1 reads 'not read' until all four of its items are done; R2 marks a pair 'not read'
edge_cases.r1_degenerate: rival a and rival b cannot both hold (a needs twin <= 2 < 3 <= fact); twin 1 with fact 2, or twin 3 with fact 4, is no call
edge_cases.token_never_seen: a token read absent (or always present) at its position in the scoring windows has zero curvature and is never a candidate

blind_to: nonlinear variables (linear reads only, user 2026-11-12); writes and reads at positions other than the last (tokens: the last two); anything off each item's windows; interventions the greedy search misses (every reading is an upper bound on the rung); differences below the read subset's sampling noise
positive_control: run 1: L1 (one neuron shifted, rung 1, n 1) and L2 (one neuron shifted by principal direction 0 at in1, rung 2, n 2), each built exactly on the list; the null: L4 (a seeded hash bit per window at in2, rung 4) and the do-nothing (rung 0)
noise_floor: two runs of the 67M differ by 1.03e-5 in mean TV; the closure's sampling sd over 16,384 read windows is not known before run 1 and is reported from the curves' read values
